title: Yonatan HaKatoni
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in a baraita in [Eruvin 96a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.96a.11); he disagrees with R' Natan.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman’s printed notice (vol. II, p. 704) cites Eruvin 96a. The supplied Hebrew transcription gives 95a. The linked baraita has Yonatan HaKitoni disagree with Rabbi Natan about wearing tefillin at night.
